correctness.rationale: The rank-sphere character table follows by row-space orthogonality and an exact triangular inversion. The rank-two multiplier exceeds the other two nonconstant multipliers by explicit positive expressions for every positive exponent. Its derivative is strictly positive and its values at zero and one straddle zero. Rank-two frequency counting gives the endpoint kernel and centered Euclidean Gram rank. Exact finite-field checks in the packaged checker passed; they corroborate rather than prove the general statement.

originality.rationale: Full-text comparison: Delsarte 1978 Theorem A2 gives the general rank-character table, but not the exact sharp p-negative-type exponent, strict rank-two obstruction, its monotonic dimension dependence, or endpoint Hilbert dimension. Gadouleau-Yan 2007 provides general rank-MacWilliams Fourier machinery without the target classification; Murugan 2011 gives a general negative-type matrix-zero criterion, not the three-column formula. Targeted published-record and indexed-literature queries did not locate stronger exact coverage. A hidden earlier specialization remains possible; no absolute priority is claimed.
residual_risks: The explicit root equation is a nontrivial specialization of a previously known full rank-character table; an older unlocated exact negative-type analysis might cover it.
The targeted published-record and semantic database searches cannot prove global uniqueness or mathematical priority.

value.rationale: The metric is the natural shortest-path metric on every diameter-three bilinear-forms graph. Its complete sharp negative-type interval is a meaningful spectral and geometric invariant, with rank-two-only obstruction, nontrivial row-dimension dependence and exact minimum Hilbert dimension. This is an all-field, all-row family, not a one-off finite count or a minor numerical change.
